checkpoints.note: First project-code statement on the witnessed crashing path that consumes attacker-controlled entity-reference syntax and materializes the entity object later reparsed as a balanced chunk.

This is the latest project statement before the reported bad-free that creates the vulnerable cleanup state seen in the sanitizer trace. The saved runtime evidence and local source support that `xmlParseBalancedChunkMemoryInternal` tears down `ctxt->myDoc->children` unconditionally after the nested parse, but do not source-groundedly disambiguate an earlier caller-side predicate in the staged tree because local `xmlParseReference` already contains the patched `if (!ctxt->wellFormed) return;` guard.
